name: context-docs-kit
description: Three skills that build and maintain a project's context/ foundation docs: bootstrapping-context-docs interviews you into a doc set, aligning-context-docs pulls the docs back in line with the code, and versioning-context-docs closes one version and opens the next.

interface.shortDescription: Interview-driven product, architecture, schema, design and rules docs
interface.longDescription: Builds a project's context/ foundation docs by interviewing you one question at a time, then keeps them aligned with the code and versioned with acceptance criteria.
